description: Full-text search the GeraSkills marketplace of AI skill packs. Match against name, description, capabilities, tags, and target user, with optional filters by category, region, maximum monthly price (USD), and badge. Returns compact cards (id, name, category, description, price, tags, marketplace url). Offline — searches the embedded 104-skill catalogue.

category.description: Exact category name. One of: Healthcare, Legal & Compliance, Education, Home & Lifestyle, Business & Finance, Agriculture & Food, Environment & Sustainability, Real Estate, Personal Finance, Government & Civic, Wellness & Mental Health, Science & Research.

max_price_monthly_usd.description: Only return skills at or below this monthly price in USD.

region.description: Region/country tag a skill is relevant to, e.g. "UK", "EU", "US", "Global".

name: search_skills
title: Search the GeraSkills catalogue
